article.title: 完形填空 · 跨部门增长团队如何突破业务增长瓶颈
article.background: 文章以 BitTorrent 的案例说明，小企业要突破增长瓶颈，需要建立跨部门增长团队，以不同专业视角协作发现问题，并由强有力的负责人统一目标、排除干扰。

sentences.en: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit, you need to find a way to take it to the next level.
sentences.zh: 这是当下许多创业者都会遇到的常见情形：你是一家小企业的首席执行官，虽然已经获得了不错的利润，却仍需要找到办法让公司更上一层楼。

segments.text: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit, you need to find a way to take it to the next level.

sentences.en: What you need to do is prioritize growth by establishing a growth team.
sentences.zh: 你需要做的是把增长置于优先位置，并组建一支增长团队。

segments.text: What you need to do is prioritize growth by establishing a growth team.

sentences.en: A growth team is made up of members from different departments within your company, and it harnesses the power of collaboration to focus exclusively on finding ways to grow.
sentences.zh: 增长团队由公司不同部门的成员组成，它借助协作的力量，专门聚焦于寻找增长路径。

segments.text: A growth team is made up of members from different departments within your company, and it harnesses the power of collaboration to focus exclusively on finding ways to grow.

sentences.en: Let's look at a real-world example.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看一个现实中的例子。

segments.text: Let's look at a real-world example.

sentences.en: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
sentences.zh: 在成立增长团队之前，软件公司 BitTorrent 有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。

segments.text: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.

sentences.en: This brought them good results until 2012, when their growth plateaued.
sentences.zh: 这种组织方式一直带来不错的结果，直到2012年公司的增长陷入停滞。

segments.text: This brought them good results until 2012, when their growth plateaued.

sentences.en: The problem was that too many customers were using the basic, free version of their product.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，太多客户只使用其产品的基础免费版本。

segments.text: The problem was that too many customers were using the basic, free version of their product.

sentences.en: And despite improvements to the premium, paid version, few people were making the upgrade.
sentences.zh: 而且，尽管付费高级版不断改进，真正升级的用户仍寥寥无几。

segments.text: And despite improvements to the premium, paid version, few people were making the upgrade.

sentences.en: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
sentences.zh: 然而，一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入后，情况发生了变化：他组建增长团队，并激发出了公司所需要的新鲜视角。

segments.text: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.

sentences.en: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.
sentences.zh: 当团队从营销角度审视工程问题时，便清楚地发现，升级不足并不是产品质量造成的。

segments.text: By looking at engineering issues from a marketing point of view, it became clear that the lack of upgrades wasn't due to a quality issue.

sentences.en: Most customers were simply unaware of the premium version and what it offered.
sentences.zh: 大多数客户只是不了解高级版，也不知道它能提供什么。

segments.text: Most customers were simply unaware of the premium version and what it offered.

sentences.en: Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.
sentences.zh: 有了这一洞见，营销和工程团队联手，通过向免费版用户醒目推广高级版来提高认知度。

segments.text: Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.

sentences.en: As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.
sentences.zh: 结果，升级量猛增，收入提高了92%。

segments.text: As a result, upgrades skyrocketed, and revenue increased by 92 percent.

sentences.en: But in order for your growth team to succeed, it needs to have a strong leader.
sentences.zh: 不过，要让增长团队取得成功，就必须有一位强有力的负责人。

segments.text: But in order for your growth team to succeed, it needs to have a strong leader.

sentences.en: It needs someone who can unite the interdisciplinary team and keep them on course for improvement.
sentences.zh: 团队需要一个能够团结跨学科成员、让大家始终沿着改进方向前进的人。

segments.text: It needs someone who can unite the interdisciplinary team and keep them on course for improvement.

sentences.en: This leader will identify the target area, set clear goals and establish a time frame for the accomplishment of these goals.
sentences.zh: 这位负责人要确定目标领域、设定清晰目标，并为目标的完成规定时间框架。

segments.text: This leader will identify the target area, set clear goals and establish a time frame for the accomplishment of these goals.

sentences.en: The growth leader is also responsible for keeping the team focused on moving forward and steering them clear of distractions.
sentences.zh: 增长团队负责人还要确保团队专注于向前推进，并使其远离干扰。

segments.text: The growth leader is also responsible for keeping the team focused on moving forward and steering them clear of distractions.

sentences.en: While attractive, new ideas can be distracting; the team leader must recognize when these ideas don't serve the current goal and need to be put on the back burner.
sentences.zh: 新的想法虽然诱人，却也可能分散注意力；团队负责人必须判断这些想法何时无助于当前目标，并把它们暂时搁置。

segments.text: While attractive, new ideas can be distracting; the team leader must recognize when these ideas don't serve the current goal and need to be put on the back burner.
